title: Low Fat Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe using low-fat ingredients. Perfect for a healthy meal.

ingredients.name: Low Fat Oil
ingredients.notes: Any low-fat cooking oil such as vegetable or canola

ingredients.name: Fresh Herbs
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh herbs such as cilantro or basil

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of low fat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the crunchy vegetables and cook until tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the herbal tea-spiced turkey breast and cook until heated through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the low sodium soy sauce and stir-fry seasoning.
Pour the sauce over the turkey and vegetables and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over cooked brown rice.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve immediately.
